variables.physical_definition: Free-stream velocity of the flow far from the boundary layer.
Kinematic viscosity of the fluid (viscosity divided by density).
Integral from the wall to the boundary-layer edge of the square of the local mean velocity with respect to wall-normal distance (i.e., ∫ U(y)^2 dy).
Boundary-layer thickness measured at 99% of the free-stream velocity.
Displacement thickness of the boundary layer (displacement effect of the boundary layer on the outer flow).
Momentum thickness of the boundary layer (momentum deficit integrated across the layer).
